calculation.outflw_peak_definition: For each grid cell, signed outflw at argmax(abs(outflw)) over valid hourly records.
calculation.pthflw_aggregation: At each record, sum signed pthflw over layers whose Rhine bifprm width is positive, then select the signed sum at argmax(abs(sum)).
calculation.missing_values: Excluded from peak selection; cells/paths with no valid records remain missing.
calculation.peak_times: Selected independently by grid cell or bifurcation path; results do not represent one simultaneous hour.

regional_figure.display: Full 40 by 32 Rhine river network in the p02-f02b direction-aware vector style; signed local outflw peaks on main-channel links, signed pthflw peaks on channel and overland bifurcations, upstream-area-scaled main lines up to 1.68 points and 1.50-point bifurcation lines, over subdued 1-minute elevation.

aoi_figure.display: Rhine standard-nextxy main network and bifurcation paths over 1-minute elevation background; arrow direction follows local peak sign; dashed channel and dotted overland-only bifurcations.

inspection.figure_review: Regenerated from 744-record standard-nextxy outputs on 2026-11-24 and visually inspected: regional river lines are visible at overview scale; AOI layout and legend are readable.

limitations: This is visualization and basic output inspection, not observation matching, numerical model validation or performance evaluation.
The run uses the model standard initial state without spin-up; initial-state effects may influence the displayed peaks.
KG-0019 remains open for ERA5-Land accumulation timing and converter period-boundary handling.
A local maximum map combines values selected at different hours; do not interpret it as a simultaneous flow field.
No hydraulic interpretation of individual negative values or scientific assessment of the simulated Rhine flood was performed.
